resources.string: Manage your Wear OS watch connection and sync
Pair a Wear OS watch with your phone to capture voice notes, mood check-ins, and more from your wrist.

Complete the system pairing prompt, then LogDate will reconnect to your watch automatically.

Get notified when a voice note or entry arrives from your watch

• Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on both devices
• Keep your watch and phone within range of each other
• Check that battery saver is not restricting LogDate
• Restart both devices if sync seems stuck
No watch is connected to this phone. Bring your watch close with Bluetooth on, then try again.
LogDate isn't installed on your watch yet. Install it first.
Your watch didn't respond. Unlock it, move it close to your phone, and try again.
Your data stays on your devices
Entries captured on your watch sync directly to this phone over Bluetooth. Nothing is sent to the cloud unless you enable cloud sync separately.

Audio plays from your phone when needed. Keep your phone nearby for recordings that are not stored on your watch.

Keep Today, Record, Mark and favorite moments close at hand.
Couldn’t check your watch. Keep it nearby and try again.
See today’s moments and start a recording. On your watch, touch and hold the current tile, swipe to Add tiles, then choose LogDate Today.
Revisit moments from this date. Add the LogDate On this day tile using Add tiles on your watch.
Touch and hold your watch face, tap Edit, then choose a complication slot. Choose LogDate Campfire, Record, Mark or On this day. Available slots depend on your watch face.
For watch reminders, open Settings on your watch, then Apps → LogDate → Permissions → Notifications.
On your watch, open Settings → Apps → LogDate → Permissions → Microphone. Allow access to record audio. LogDate never records until you start a recording.
Your watch can record moments. Open Watch settings to choose what it keeps.
Last reported unsent moments: %1$s. If the watch is offline, these and any newer unsent moments may be lost.

When the watch is nearby, LogDate syncs its moments before removing it. If it is offline, LogDate revokes its access now and queues erasure for its next connection. Unsent moments on the watch may be lost. Your phone journal and backed-up moments stay safe.
No verified watch link is available. Set up the watch again before removing it securely.
Watch removed. Its retained LogDate data has been erased.
Watch access revoked. LogDate will erase its local data when it reconnects. Unsent moments on that watch may be lost.
Removal isn’t complete. Keep the watch nearby and try again. Recording on the watch may pause until this finishes.
Keep audio ready under this policy. You can always play other moments on demand.
Nothing from this day in past years
Your recording rhythm, with the current Campfire state. Tap to open LogDate.
A microphone shortcut. Tap to start a voice recording.
Save the current moment without opening LogDate.
A memory from a past year. Tap to open its moment.

Turn on your watch and follow its setup screen to install your watch maker’s companion app on this phone. Complete pairing in that app, then return to LogDate. If the watch does not show setup instructions, use its manufacturer’s setup guide. Wear OS 3 and later use manufacturer companion apps, rather than the older Wear OS by Google app.
Couldn’t open the companion app or its store listing. Try again.
Connect a Wear OS watch to this phone before checking LogDate’s connection. Complete setup in your watch maker’s companion app, return here, and check again.
